summary: First iteration backend-only testing for NOVA ASİSTAN. Created pytest suite with 20 tests covering root, auth guards (401), auth/session invalid, auth/me via injected signed cookie, tasks full CRUD + context filtering (kisisel/komagene/tiyatral-nikah/bora-ai-studyo), notes CRUD + context filter, events CRUD + date range filter, chat (Turkish answer + message persistence to db.messages), briefing/today (text/events/priorities/pending_count/date), TTS mp3 stream + empty-text 400, and logout session deletion. All 20 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager.
PATCH /api/tasks accepts raw dict body — switch to a Pydantic TaskUpdate model to enforce validation and types (e.g., is_priority must be bool).

briefing/today date range filter uses string prefix match on start_time; works for ISO strings but will miss events saved in other timezones; consider using proper datetime comparison or indexable date field.
SESSION_SECRET is a hardcoded default-looking value in .env — ensure it is rotated for production.
Chat and briefing have no timeout on LlmChat calls; a hanging upstream could block workers. Consider asyncio.wait_for wrapping.
STT/TTS use base_url 'https://integrations.emergentagent.com/llm' with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — not tested end-to-end for STT (no audio sample) but TTS confirmed working and returning audio/mpeg.
test_credentials: Injected signed nova_session cookie for synthetic MongoDB user id=TEST_bora. SESSION_SECRET read from backend/.env. Cleanup fixture removes all TEST_* data from users/sessions/tasks/notes/events/messages after suite.
seed_data_creation: Per-test TEST_-prefixed tasks/notes/events/messages; auto-cleaned via session-scoped teardown fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_nova_backend.py runs in ~9s with xdist. STT not covered (no sample audio). Chat/briefing/TTS hit live OpenAI via Emergent proxy — expect occasional slowness; timeouts set to 60s. Use conftest.auth_client fixture (signed cookie) for any new authenticated endpoint tests.
